title: The Pratfall Effect: Why Mistakes Make You Likable

visual.description: A man in a sharp suit adjusting his tie in a mirror looking serious.

vo.en: Here is why: when a highly competent person makes a tiny blunder, we actually like them much more.
vo.fr: Voici pourquoi : quand quelqu'un de brillant fait une petite gaffe, on finit par l'apprécier encore plus.

visual.description: Coffee splashing onto a white table next to a laptop and papers.

vo.en: It’s called the Pratfall Effect. These small mistakes make you seem human and far more approachable.
vo.fr: C'est l'Effet de Chute. Tes erreurs te rendent simplement plus humain et beaucoup plus accessible.

visual.description: A close-up of hands fumbling with keys or dropping a metal pen.

vo.en: Total perfection acts like a wall, but showing vulnerability is the bridge that builds instant social trust.
vo.fr: La perfection est un mur, alors que la vulnérabilité est un pont qui crée une confiance immédiate.

visual.description: A wooden suspension bridge spanning across a lush green forest canyon.

vo.en: Psychologists discovered that audiences preferred an expert who spilled coffee over one who was completely flawless.
vo.fr: Des psychologues ont prouvé qu'on préfère un expert maladroit à une personne qui ne se trompe jamais.

visual.description: Orange juice splashing out of a glass in slow motion on a wooden table.

vo.en: So stop hiding your slips and trips. They are exactly what make others feel safe around you.
vo.fr: Ne cache plus tes maladresses. Ce sont elles qui mettent les autres à l'aise à tes côtés.

visual.description: A man laughing naturally and gesturing with his hands in an outdoor setting.

vo.en: Follow for a daily brain bias check. Because honestly, you should...
vo.fr: Abonne-toi pour ton check-up mental. Car franchement, tu devrais...

visual.description: Close up of a hand scrolling through a smartphone screen in a dark room.
